newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba's Welteke backs speedy conversion to Euro.
newsitem.headline: Buba's Welteke backs speedy conversion to Euro.

text.p: Bundesbank council member Ernst Welteke said on Monday he would prefer to have securities denominated in the new European currency, the euro, as soon as monetary union begins.

"I am arguing that all current securities be converted in euros immediately," Welteke told journalists, but added that such a decision would be taken by the Finance Ministry rather than the central bank.
"(Finance Minister Theo) Waigel must decide that and I don't know when he will do that."
Welteke is also president of the state central bank in Hesse. Europe's planned currency union is expected to be launched on January 1, 1999.
